As I figure it, the beginning of your turn goes like this:

A) Do I have a turn? (First Tradition Decision).
B) "until next turn/untap phase" effects expire. Malkavian Dementia'd vampires
are returned, withdrawal succeeds, redraw Wakes, etc.
C) Checks at "beginning of turn" are made. Is Club Zombie untapped? Is
Bartholomew untapped? Which of my cards do not untap as normal?
D) Untap all cards that untap as normal.
E) Start doing the "during your untap phase" effects.

No "during your untap phase" effects can be used from A-D. Quirky things like
Vampiric Disease can be triggered in phase D, though.

A) Will I have a turn? - 1st Trad
B) Things that end "until my next turn", "until next untap phase" end
BEFORE I untap cards.
UNTAP PHASE STARTS
C) Untap cards and check any "If Card X is tapped/untapped" (Cry Wolf,
Bartholemew, Club Zombie, etc)
D) "During your untap phase..." effects (HGs, Society of Leopold,
Smiling Jack...)
E) End of your Untap Phase

> > C) Checks at "beginning of turn" are made. �Is Club Zombie untapped? Is

> > D) Untap all cards that untap as normal.

> As far as I understood, Untapping of cards happened automatically as

> soon as the untap phase commenced. So C & D happen simultaneously.

> C) Untap cards and check any "If Card X is tapped/untapped" (Cry Wolf,
> Bartholemew, Club Zombie, etc)

I think we're arguing semantics.
You have to check if these things were true before you physically
untap the cards, and then use the results of that check after you
physically untap them. Otherwise, Club Zombie could be used for both
its effects, which is not the intent.
